status: Optional bounded stream/web foundation selected only by NODE_COMPAT_STREAM_WEB=ON; requires the existing native web streams and text-codec builtins. No host interface is selected. Support is limited to the explicit policy below.
moduleContract: Exactly the 17 pinned Node22 named exports plus default. The mutable ordinary default object initially maps each name to the same function; ESM bindings capture initial values without syncBuiltinESMExports. Proposed literal CommonJS lowering returns default; runtime require remains excluded. Private record capture is guest implementation detail, never a host service.

node:stream/web.callablePolicy: Reuse thirteen real native stream/strategy constructors, implement native-bulk UTF8 codec stream facades plus serialized ReadableStream.from/values/asyncIterator, and adapt ordinary DataView BYOB requests through same-backing Uint8Array views. Compression/decompression bindings are explicit functions throwing ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED when called or constructed. All unsupported and resource-limit errors use own coded properties; no Proxy export substitute.
deviations: This optional bounded module does not claim complete node:stream/web or Web Streams conformance. Existing native operations beyond the recorded ordinary corpus retain their existing implementation and unverified overloads.

TextDecoderStream supports UTF8 only through native label normalization. Other known native labels throw ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED after the recorded getter effects; unknown labels use RangeError ERR_ENCODING_NOT_SUPPORTED.

Decoder inputs are fixed attached unshared BufferSources. Shared, resizable and detached decoder inputs are rejected explicitly; native generic TextDecoder retains its separate broader contract. Buffer-source validation can materialize inline typed-array ArrayBuffers.

BYOB supports only ordinary local unmodified fixed unshared typed-array/DataView views with default/null/min1. min>1, shared/resizable backing, subclass/cross-realm/modified layout views are rejected. Proxy reader receivers are excluded although Node22 can accept a Proxy of a genuine reader.

DataView requests use a Uint8Array view over the same backing/offset/length, then a DataView over the moved result. This introduces no explicit byte copy but makes no claim about native transfer copies. The broken old-native DataView branch is never entered.

WritableStreamDefaultController.signal remains absent and requires native implementation; it is not fabricated from sink.abort. Native retained constructor error codes and Transform controller arity have recorded differences.
A released native BYOB reader throws TypeError without Node ERR_INVALID_STATE. Source error objects retain identity; this difference is not hidden by message parsing or blanket TypeError relabeling.

The optional profile replaces eight static/prototype descriptors while preserving native constructor/prototype identities. Installation runs once in the content realm before application initialization; no runtime syncBuiltinESMExports is provided.

The uninitialized Transform controller prototype is rejected by guarded public operations. Native class/slot validation independently protects web methods. The Node-facing wrapper attaches ERR_INVALID_THIS for that prototype only; other invalid native receiver paths can retain uncoded TypeError. Full receiver error-code parity is not claimed.

Native classes are captured through public JS_GetClassObject and existing retained prototype roots in the content realm. The private BYOB callback uses public JS::IsReadableStreamBYOBReader and excludes scripted Proxy receivers; no temporary initialization streams or public test hook is used.

from uses HWM0, async protocol preference and an async-from-sync generator bridge. values serializes pending next/return, releases/cancels on close/error/return, supports preventCancel. Arbitrary protocol mutation, Promise.prototype.then immunity, worker transfer and cross-realm semantics are not claimed.

Per-operation input caps do not bound application-retained queues, total lifetime stream output or arbitrarily many queued iterator calls. Compression output limits, native allocation failure/fatal Rust allocator behavior and complete scheduler/async-context behavior remain separate gates.
No new global TextEncoderStream/TextDecoderStream name is installed by this module proposal; existing native global constructor identities are reused where present.

CompressionStream and DecompressionStream remain explicit import-only/deferred callable bindings until ownership, cleanup, malformed-input and expansion-budget hardening and ordinary tests pass. No native compression transform was invoked by these candidate tests.
